_about: Fit score (src/jobhunter/fitgrade.py, rubric.py): each shown job gets 0-100 points by your rubric (skills match 40, visa and location 30, salary and company 30, with the interview style 20 of those). Sorting only: it never changes a job's status, never hides or rejects one. The model reads the posting for seniority, required skills, domain, benefits, equity and interviews, each quoted; code checks the quotes and adds up every part. The salary floors are FIT_SALARY_FLOORS in .env, never here. `enabled` controls the daily run; `jobhunter grade` works either way.
_model: claude-code:opus uses the Claude Code CLI on your Claude login (no API bill, about 20-40 s a job, counts against your plan). deepseek-v4-flash also works (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, about $0.002 a job).
_max_jobs_per_run: A cap per run. The rest wait for the next run or `jobhunter grade`.
_lookback_days: Shown jobs filed under the last this-many days are scored while you have not acted on them (New or Saved).
_interview: When a posting does not say how they interview, the company is looked up once on the web (Claude Code with web search), its quote checked on the page code fetches, and kept for interview_recheck_days. At most max_interview_lookups_per_run companies a run, best score first. 0 turns it off.
